coverage.fileStatistics: whole decoded file when practical; deterministic stride sampling for very large inputs
coverage.spectralPitchKey: fast inspector uses bounded representative center windows: a short preview for spectrum and monophonic pitch, plus a longer 20 s window resampled to 16 kHz for musical key
coverage.rhythm: fast inspector uses a bounded representative center window resampled to 16 kHz with anti-alias averaging and a 1024/128 STFT
coverage.wholeSongRhythm: explicit song-analysis page analyzes the complete decoded track up to 15 minutes, mixed to mono and resampled to at most 16 kHz before the Rust/WASM rhythm operation runs
coverage.wholeSongKey: explicit song-analysis page sends the complete bounded Float32 PCM track through the Rust musical-key analyzer, aligns the temporal decoder to Rust-owned downbeats when a stable bar path exists, and exports confidence-bearing windows plus stable non-overlapping key segments
coverage.wholeSongStructure: Rust rhythm analysis aligns structural candidates to inferred downbeats and combines multiband spectral energy, onset novelty, harmonic chroma, and earlier-material recurrence into confidence-bearing A/B/A-style identities
coverage.wholeSongOverview: presentation-only browser rendering derives a bounded frequency-colored low/mid/high overview from the already local PCM, then overlays Rust-owned beats, downbeats, sections, BPM, key, and confidence without creating a second semantic analyzer

backend.note: Heavy model execution is an opt-in local deployment boundary and is never triggered automatically by the public Pages site.
